correctness.rationale: The order-preserving bijection from prefix ranks to suffix ranks is uniquely determined by the ordered first k values and last-k value set. Its residue-class chains reconstruct at most one permutation, with termination and distinctness checks providing an if-and-only-if test. Enumerating all (n+1)^k insertion ranks counts every labeled closed walk exactly once. This proves O_k(n^(3k+1)) arithmetic operations for n>=2k. Two self-loop repetitions are the only nonsimple rooted closed three-walks for n>3. Exact C++ integer computation through n=24 and a separately implemented full-graph adjacency trace for n<=8 agree on all common cases.

value.rationale: A previously identified enumeration challenge in a natural graph of consecutive order patterns is addressed with a uniform polynomial-for-fixed-k exact method that replaces factorial vertex enumeration. This is a structural reconstruction lemma, not a routine table increment. Its first complete computational application gives all labeled directed three-cycle counts across 19 consecutive graph sizes to order 24, including parallel-edge multiplicities, with a separately reproducible graph-trace cross-check.
